messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Silverline renewal hit a snag: procurement flagged the e-sign because of VAT language + they want an invoice/PO flow. Can we route this to legal + finance?

todd_ae: @maria_cs thanks. Do we have the exact PO requirements? net30 vs net45? company legal wants the clause adjusted?

maria_cs: Keith (customer) said they need net45 and VAT reversed charged. Also they asked if the 10% expansion discount still applies if they sign by EOW.

keith_silverline: hey team — yes, net45 is our standard for EMEA. VAT reverse charge needed per our AP. discount ok if signature by Fri. can you send final with PO lines?

ana_legal: tagging in. quick read: current contract has "Taxes: customer" language. we can add a VAT addendum for reverse-charge but need to confirm jurisdiction and invoice format. i'll draft.

ana_legal: draft snippet: `We will rely on Customer's determination of reverse-charge applicability; Customer shall provide VAT exemption certificate or local tax authority confirmation within 14 days.` pls confirm this approach.

keith_silverline: that looks fine, legal team will provide the certificate after signing.

finance_ops: FYI: for net45 + PO we'll need invoice cadence: one invoice on activation, one on annual renewal date. PO number field must be on the invoice header. Also we require billing contact: accounts@silverline.co.

maria_cs: Perfect. Todd — can you prepare the updated amendment (VAT addendum + net45 + 10% promo) and send to esign? I'll attach the PO once Keith confirms the number.

todd_ae: on it. I'll make two small edits: (1) add invoice header fields, (2) explicit promo clause: "10% off ARR if Signed on or before 2026-03-27". Drafting now.

esign_bot: New e-sign envelope created: https://redwood.esign/ENV-49821 
Envelope contains: Master Services Agreement (amendment), VAT Addendum, Invoice Template. Status: draft.

maria_cs: Keith — can you drop the PO number here when you have it so Finance can match?

keith_silverline: PO# SL-2026-7789 — we'll route internally today. 

finance_ops: Received PO# SL-2026-7789. will accept invoice once esign completed and VAT doc attached.

ana_legal: final question: do we want the addendum to include a fallback for disputed VAT? propose: `If reverse-charge cannot be applied, parties agree to cooperate on tax gross-up as needed.` Thoughts?

maria_cs: Keep it simple — include the fallback but limit liability: `cooperate in good faith` and no retro gross-up beyond 30 days.

ana_legal: ok updating. will push final to envelope.

todd_ae: pushed updated docs to envelope ENV-49821 and toggled signers: keith_silverline (customer), todd_ae (sales sig), maria_cs (cs witness).

esign_bot: Envelope ENV-49821 status: Sent to keith_silverline for signature. Email sent to keith@silverline.co.

keith_silverline: signed. confirmation email came through.

esign_bot: Envelope ENV-49821 status: Completed. Signed copies: https://redwood.esign/ENV-49821/download

finance_ops: thank you — processing invoice creation now. will send PDF to accounts@silverline.co with PO on header.

maria_cs: Great wrap. tracking notes: renewal closed-won, 10% promo honored, net45, VAT addendum attached, PO SL-2026-7789. I'll update SFDC and handshake with onboarding team for kickoff next week. :tada:

todd_ae: awesome, thanks everyone :+1:

ana_legal: adding signed docs to contract record. :memo:

maria_cs: Closing thread — ping me if anything else pops up.
